messages:
amy: Heads-up — prepping to cut over the compact analytics adapter tomorrow AM. Putting the canary plan here for feedback.
noah: Nice, can you summarize the failure modes we should watch?
maria: Main risks: index bloat during backfill, quota mis-hydration causing false throttles, dashboard queries blowing p99 on read adapter.
kevin: Also watch route-tagging differences — adapter maps route_id -> route_profile slightly differently, we need compatibility layer.
amy: Plan (short): 1) deploy adapter in shadow mode; 2) dual-write compact events + envelopev1 to kafka; 3) run backfill for 7 days window via workers; 4) enable canary reads at 1% tenants; 5) ramp to 25% then 100%.
maria: Shadow mode telemetry will need a new metric: analytics.adapter.shadow_error_rate. Add alert at 2% over 15m.
noah: For backfill, do we create the new indexes up-front? That will slow writes. I vote create indexes concurrently and do backfill in small batches.
kevin: Agreed. SQL we plan to run (concurrent):
```sql
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_compact_route_ts ON compact_events (route_id, bucket_ts DESC)
```
amy: Backfill job config (worker):
```yaml
batch_size: 5000
parallelism: 8
retry_policy: exponential(1m, 5)
throttle_tokens: 200
max_window_days: 30
```
kevin: For quota hydration, adapter exposes a shim that populates quota_profile_id. We must ensure legacy consumers tolerate nulls during ramp. Add tolerant read-layer that falls back to legacy lookup if null.
maria: Dashboard team: please add a toggle in Console to flip read adapter to compact for selected orgs. UX should show last sync time + backfill progress.
amy: Console flag snippet (feature flags):
```json
{
 "feature": "compact_analytics_reads",
 "canary": {"pct": 1, "orgs": []},
 "stages": [1,25,100]
}
```
infra-bot: deploy queued: analytics-adapter-shadow v3.2 -> staging starting in 15m :rocket:
noah: Monitoring checklist before canary:
- shadow_error_rate < 0.5% over 1h
- read_latency_p50 < 200ms, p99 < 1200ms for canary orgs
- backfill_throughput >= 200k events/min
- failed_dualwrites == 0 (alert)
kevin: Rollback triggers: any sustained p99 read spike >2x baseline for 10m OR failed_dualwrites > 0.1% for 5m. Rollback action: flip feature flag to legacy reads, pause backfill, scale down adapter.
amy: We also need a read-adapter compatibility test harness — simulate console queries (card endpoints) against compact read adapter and compare top-k results with legacy read for 1k sample tenants. Running this now.
maria: Small note: for tenant-metadata joins we changed route_label->route_key mapping to de-dup on (tenant_id, route_key). That will change counts slightly; add disclaimer to dashboards that migration may change historical counts by small amounts.
noah: Ops: ensure we have snapshots before index creation and before canary ramp. Also plan DB maintenance window if index build causes IO spike.
kevin: Security: key rotation for KMS used in private telemetry export is paused during cutover — confirmed with secops.
amy: Timelines: staging smoke tonight, canary tomorrow 9:00 UTC (1% for 2h), ramp to 25% tomorrow 15:00 UTC if healthy, full cutover Friday 03:00 UTC.
maria: I'll own dashboard toggle + progress card in Console. Noah can you handle the backfill workers and throttling?
noah: Yep. I'll post a short runbook in #release-war-room before canary.
amy: Quick runbook snippet for oncall: steps to revert if read p99 spikes:
1) Flip feature flag to 0% canary in Console UI
2) Pause backfill (api /admin/backfill/pause)
3) Scale down analytics-adapter deployment to 0
4) Verify legacy reads restored, postmortem channel: #incidents
kevin: One more: log schema change — add event_type varchar(32) to compact_events; ensure log parsers handle missing field for old events.
amy: Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the plan or :warning: for issues. We'll run the canary only if no warnings by EOD.
maria: :thumbsup:
noah: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
infra-bot: staging deploy started successfully :white_check_mark:
